function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verify the customer's identity using the account ID and verification code. This tool must succeed with verified=true before any loan, overdue, balance, debt, or payment information is disclosed.

account_id.description: The account ID associated with the current customer. Use the account ID provided by the current call context. Never invent an account ID.

verification_code.description: The verification value provided by the customer, such as the last 4 digits of PAN or year of birth.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Record a customer's Promise-to-Pay commitment after the customer explicitly agrees to make a payment.

account_id.description: The verified customer's account ID from the current call context.

ptp_date.description: The date the customer promises to make the payment, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

amount.description: The amount the customer explicitly commits to pay.

payment_method.description: The payment method selected by the customer, if provided. Examples: UPI, bank transfer, card.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Send a payment link to the authenticated customer's registered contact channel after the customer agrees to make a payment.

account_id.description: The verified customer's account ID from the current call context.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment link should be sent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Record the final outcome of the current customer call after the required action has been completed.

account_id.description: The verified customer's account ID from the current call context.

status.description: The final disposition of the call.

notes.description: A concise description of the outcome and any relevant customer-provided information.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalate the authenticated customer's case to a human agent when human assistance is required, including disputes, hardship requests, complaints, or explicit customer requests.

account_id.description: The verified customer's account ID from the current call context.

reason.description: The reason the customer requires human assistance.

priority.description: The priority assigned to the escalation.

notes.description: Relevant context that should be passed to the human agent.
